description: This file defines abstract classes for map data layers and data layer items used in a mapping component, specifically for handling latest data points on a map with editing, selection, and tooltip functionalities.

classes.name: TbLatestDataLayerItem
classes.description: Abstract class representing a data item on the latest data layer, with functionalities for selection, editing, tooltip management, and interaction with map layers.

classes.name: TbLatestMapDataLayer
classes.description: Abstract class representing a data layer for latest data points on a map, supporting editing modes, data updates, and item placement.

methods.name: invalidateCoordinates
methods.description: Invalidates the coordinates of the data item, prompting a refresh or recalculation.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects the data item, updates UI state, and optionally provides removal options.

methods.name: deselect
methods.description: Deselects the data item, updating UI state accordingly.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the data item is currently selected.

methods.name: editModeUpdated
methods.description: Updates the item's state based on current edit mode and selection.

methods.name: dragModeUpdated
methods.description: Updates the item's drag mode state based on current settings.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the data associated with the item.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the data item from the map layer.

methods.name: isEditing
methods.description: Returns false; meant to be overridden in subclasses to indicate editing state.

methods.name: bindEvents
methods.description: Binds event handlers for map interactions like click events.

methods.name: enableEdit
methods.description: Enables editing mode for the data item.

methods.name: disableEdit
methods.description: Disables editing mode for the data item.

methods.name: updateSelectedState
methods.description: Updates visual state to reflect whether the item is selected.

methods.name: updateTooltip
methods.description: Updates the tooltip content for the data item.

methods.name: updateLabel
methods.description: Updates the label displayed on the data item.

methods.name: canDeselect
methods.description: Determines if the item can be deselected.

methods.name: onSelected
methods.description: Hook called when the item is selected; can be overridden to add custom buttons.

methods.name: onDeselected
methods.description: Hook called when the item is deselected.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Abstract method to create a map layer for the data item.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Abstract method to update the map layer with new data.

methods.name: doInvalidateCoordinates
methods.description: Abstract method to invalidate the coordinates of the data item.

methods.name: unbindLabel
methods.description: Abstract method to unbind label from the map layer.

methods.name: bindLabel
methods.description: Abstract method to bind a label to the map layer.

methods.name: addItemClass
methods.description: Abstract method to add a CSS class to the map layer.

methods.name: removeItemClass
methods.description: Abstract method to remove a CSS class from the map layer.

methods.name: enableDrag
methods.description: Abstract method to enable dragging of the map layer.

methods.name: disableDrag
methods.description: Abstract method to disable dragging of the map layer.

methods.name: updateBubblingMouseEvents
methods.description: Abstract method to update mouse event bubbling behavior.

methods.name: removeDataItemTitle
methods.description: Abstract method to get the title for removing a data item.

methods.name: removeDataItem
methods.description: Abstract method to remove the data item, returning an Observable.

methods.name: placeItem
methods.description: Abstract method to place an unplaced data item on the map layer.

methods.name: isValidLayerData
methods.description: Abstract method to validate if layer data is suitable for this layer.

methods.name: createLayerItem
methods.description: Abstract method to create a map layer item from data.
